resources.string: Turn off Telegram passcode before enabling stealth mode.
Only show settings when using a hidden account
Hidden accounts use a separate 4-digit unlock code. When app passcode is enabled, entering a hidden account code on the passcode prompt opens that account for the current session.
Stealth mode hides hidden accounts without enabling the regular app passcode. Enter a hidden account code in the chat search field to open that account for the current session.
Enable Telegram passcode or stealth mode before hiding accounts.

Only hidden accounts get an extra unlock code. At least one account must remain visible.\n\nThe unlock code controls in-app access only. It is not encryption — chat data, media, and credentials remain readable to anyone with full device access (root, backup extraction, or a compromised system).
You can\'t disable stealth mode while hidden accounts exist and app passcode is off.
You can\'t disable app passcode while hidden accounts exist unless stealth mode is enabled.
At least one signed-in account must stay visible.
This account will become visible again in account switchers, settings, and notifications.
Enter the current unlock code before changing this hidden account.
Use a separate 4-digit code for this account. Hidden account codes must be unique and cannot match the app passcode.
This unlock code is already used by another hidden account.
This unlock code matches the app passcode. Use a different code.
Use rear camera for video messages
Long press title bar to temporarily show it
No UnifiedPush distributor app is installed. Install one to receive push notifications.

Delivers notifications through Google Play Services on this device, using the Mercurygram gateway to sign them. No Google library is bundled in the app, but Google learns when a notification is sent to you and Play Services must stay installed. Any other distributor keeps Google out of the path entirely.
URL prefix for the UnifiedPush gateway
The default ntfy.sh server has very low rate limits and blocks Mercurygram\'s push gateway. Push notifications will not work reliably.
Mercurygram has automatically switched to: %1$s\n\nIf you want to use ntfy, please configure it with a self-hosted server.
No alternative distributors are installed. UnifiedPush will be disabled. You can re-enable it after installing a compatible distributor with a self-hosted server.
⚠ The default ntfy.sh server is blocked. Push notifications will not work. Please use a self-hosted ntfy server or switch to a different distributor.
Mercurygram will no longer check for updates on GitHub at startup. You can still trigger a manual check from the button below.

Receive 5-dotted pre-release builds (such as 12.6.4.4.42) via the in-app updater. These are development snapshots taken between stable releases; they may contain crashes, partially-working features, or other regressions. You can disable this option later to roll back to the matching 4-dotted stable.

Pre-release Mercurygram builds (5-dotted, such as 12.6.4.4.42) are development snapshots produced between stable releases. They may contain undiscovered crashes, partially-working features, or other regressions. You can disable this option later to roll back to the matching 4-dotted stable. Continue?
Send only the still photo when picking a Google Motion Photo. You can still enable Live Photo for an individual selection by tapping the motion icon in the attach panel.
Pre-selects \"Delete for everyone\" (and \"Also delete for…\" in private chats) when deleting messages. You can still untick it before confirming.
Global search looks up public usernames, channels and messages across Telegram. With this off, search only covers your own chats and contacts.
Hides the AI button in the message and caption editors. The AI editor sends your draft to Telegram\'s AI service to rewrite, proofread or restyle it.
Hides the AI Summary button on messages. Summaries send the message text to Telegram\'s AI service.
Don\'t fetch web page previews while composing. This stops Telegram\'s servers from loading links you type or paste. Previews stay off in every chat.

When you tap the compose button to start a new conversation, create an end-to-end encrypted secret chat instead of a regular one. Secret chats live only on this device and don\'t sync across your devices. Existing chats and other ways to open a chat are unaffected.
Replace the bundled Roboto fonts with the device system fonts. Existing screens may need to be reopened for the change to fully apply.

Deleted messages stay in the chat, grayed out and non-replyable; edited messages keep their previous versions accessible from the message menu. Stored separately from the Telegram cache. Self-destructing messages and secret chats are never saved.
Permanently delete all saved deleted and edited messages?

When disabled, Mercurygram stops receiving push notifications. Background delivery then depends on Telegram\'s own connection: enable Background Connection or Keep-Alive Service in Settings → Notifications and Sounds if you still want messages while the app is closed.
Refreshes the session key every hour instead of once a day. Makes passive correlation of your device harder. Background network activity will be slightly higher.

Mercurygram will rotate the session key every hour instead of once a day. This makes it harder for a passive observer on your network to correlate your device, but does not hide that you use Telegram and does not defeat traffic analysis (timing, volume, contacts). The first session key on a fresh login is still observable once, and background network activity will be slightly higher. Continue?
Account %1$s reverted to standard mode — server rejected the reduced session-key lifetime.
Server rejected the reduced session-key lifetime for: %1$s. Those accounts use the standard 24h key. Turn off and on to retry.
Tor crashed repeatedly. Auto-restart paused — toggle Tor off and on to retry.
Tor plugin not installed. Install it to enable Tor.

Routes Telegram protocol traffic (MTProto) through an embedded Tor daemon to defeat the passive auth_key_id tracking that lets network operators link your account to your real IP. Media downloads and other HTTP traffic stay direct so the app stays responsive. Tor disconnects automatically when the app is idle to save battery and restarts when needed. Latency-sensitive features (calls) may suffer; Telegram still sees the Tor exit.

Mercurygram will start an embedded Tor daemon and route Telegram protocol traffic (MTProto) through it. Media downloads and other HTTP traffic stay direct. Bootstrap takes ~10–30 seconds the first time. Tor shuts down automatically when the app has been idle to save battery, and starts again on resume or when a push arrives. Continue?

Where a network blocks Tor directly (as in Russia and Iran), pick Snowflake to route the Tor handshake through a domain-fronted relay so it can still connect, with no setup. Or pick obfs4 bridges if you have bridge lines from @GetBridgesBot. Direct connection is fastest where Tor is not blocked.
Paste obfs4 bridge lines, one per line. Get them from @GetBridgesBot on Telegram.
No valid obfs4 bridge found. Each line must start with \"obfs4\". Get bridges from @GetBridgesBot on Telegram.
Turn Tor off to use a different proxy.
Failed to download Tor plugin. Check your connection and try again.
Tor plugin: signature mismatch — refusing to bind
Pick how Mercurygram translates received messages.

Telegram cloud sends the text to Telegram\'s servers (which forward to Google). Alternative HTTP routes the text through a public Mozhi privacy proxy that aggregates several engines (DuckDuckGo, LibreTranslate, Google, MyMemory, Reverso) — pick the engine and instance below. Offline delegates each translation to a separate FOSS app (Offline Translator, dev.davidv.translator) over a background bound service — the message never leaves your device. Bold, italic, and code formatting may be lost on the offline path because the engine returns plain text.

Offline Translator (dev.davidv.translator) is the reference FOSS provider — bundles offline Bergamot models and exposes a background bound service that Mercurygram dispatches each translation to silently. Until it is installed, translations stay on whatever fallback you allow below.
Offline Translator is installed. Open it once to download the language pair(s) you want to translate from and to.

If the offline translator returns nothing (no model for the language pair, language not detected, service unreachable), fall back to the Alternative HTTP path. Cloud is never used as a fallback when you picked the offline engine for privacy.
Bold, italic, and code formatting may be lost when translating with the offline engine.
Offline translation: no model installed for %1$s. Open Offline Translator to download it.
Offline translation: could not detect the source language.
Offline translation: provider unavailable. Open or reinstall Offline Translator.
Transcribe voice and video messages locally with Whisper. Audio never leaves your device, and it works without Telegram Premium. Requires a downloaded model.

\"Automatic\" lets the model detect the spoken language on its own. \"Device language\" or a specific language pins it for every model — useful because the smaller models often mis-detect short messages.

Detects speech and skips silent parts before transcribing, so the model can\'t invent words during silence. Recommended, especially for the smaller models. Uses a tiny extra model downloaded with the main one.
Models are open-source (MIT). Download once over the network, or import a file you already have. The model is stored on your device and used fully offline.
On-device transcription: no model installed. Download one in Mercurygram settings.
On-device transcription: audio file not available. Try playing the message first.
On-device transcription: could not decode the audio.
Load your own emoji images instead of the built-in set.
Render emoji from an imported pack instead of the built-in set. Any emoji the pack is missing falls back to the built-in one.
Pick a .zip of emoji images, or an official Telegram APK to extract its emoji from. The pack is your own file, stored on your device and never shared. Missing emoji fall back to the built-in set.
Translations are processed by the selected Mozhi instance. The operator may log them.
This user is unknown to this app, so it can\'t be mentioned. Pick them from your contacts instead.
